data.name: AlJabal
data.gender_notes: AlJabal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, AlJabal refers to a mountain in Mecca, Mount Thawr, where Prophet Ibrahim and his son Ismail built the Kaaba. It symbolizes steadfastness, strength, and devotion to Allah. The name AlJabal carries the meaning “The Mountain” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlJabal usually hope their child will grow to embody the mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing faith, perseverance, and the strength of Allah's creation.
data.etymology: AlJabal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlJabal total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: الجبل
in_arabic.meaning: المرتفع من الأرض الجبلية، مكان عال و رفيع
in_arabic.long_meaning: الجبل هو الاسم الذي يطلق على المرتفعات العالية من الأرض، و هو مكان رفيع وعال يتصف بصلابته ومتانته، وقد وردت كلمة الجبل في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: «وَتَرَى الْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَهِيَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ السَّحَابِ» [الفرقان: 2]، و الجبل في اللغة العربية يرمز إلى القوة والصلابة.

in_urdu.name: الجبل
in_urdu.meaning: اونچی زمین کا حصہ، پہاڑ، عالمی مقام
in_urdu.long_meaning: الجبل کا مطلب ہوتا ہے اونچی زمین کا حصہ یا پہاڑ، جو کہ ایک بلند و بالا مقام کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، یہ نام عربی زبان کی جڑوں سے نکلا ہے اور اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا اہم کردار ہے، پہاڑ کو قوت اور مضبوطی کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے، اور یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں وسیع پیمانے پر استعمال ہوتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: अलजबल
in_hindi.meaning: उंचे पर्वत, उच्च भूमि का भाग
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलजबल नाम का अर्थ होता है उंचे पर्वत या उच्च भूमि का भाग, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है, यह नाम अरबी जड़ों से निकला है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है, पहाड़ को शक्ति और मजबूती के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है.

in_pashto.name: الجبل
in_pashto.long_meaning: الجبل د لوړو ساحو یا غرونو نوم دی، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو تر منځ يو مشهور نوم دی، غرونه د قوت او مضبوطۍ نښه ګڼل کیږي، دا نوم د پښتو ژبې د ګرامر او لغت له مخې ډیر زیات کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: AlJabal
in_english.long_meaning: AlJabal is derived from the Arabic root 'جبل' which means to elevate or to rise, it refers to a high place, mountain, or elevated land, this name has a significant presence in Islamic tradition and is mentioned in the Quran, for example, 'And you see the mountains, you think them to be stagnant, while they are moving like the movement of clouds.' [Al-Furqan: 2], the mountain symbolizes strength, stability, and elevation.

data.cultural_impact: AlJabal, in Islamic culture, refers to Mount Thawr, situated near the Islamic holy city of Mecca. According to Islamic tradition, it is the mountain where Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) and his son Ismail built the Kaaba, Islam's most sacred site. AlJabal holds immense significance in Islamic history as it is one of the three sacred mountains mentioned in the Quran, alongside Al-Tur and Al-Safa. This mountain establishes a deep connection between Muslims and their faith, as they reach out to Allah through their pilgrimage to Mecca, making AlJabal a powerful symbol of Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, AlJabal in Islamic tradition represents steadfastness, strength, and devotion to Allah. It is the site where Ibrahim and Ismail stood together, demonstrating their unwavering commitment to build the Kaaba, the fundamental symbol of unity and submission to God. The mountain's spiritual significance underscores the connection between the physical act of pilgrimage, spiritual transformation, and the deeply personal bond between Allah and His believers. Additionally, AlJabal symbolizes the trials and tribulations that every believer faces in their faith journey, reflecting the underlying theme of strength and submission to Allah's will.

historical_references.context: Al-Jabal was a significant military stronghold during the Byzantine-Arab Wars and the Rashidun Caliphate.
